chunks: Humayd, from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, from someone else, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who buys the slave girl, so he copulates with her, and he finds her pregnant, he said: He should return her, and return something along with her.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on returning a pregnant slave girl and paying compensation after copulation?
ai.summary: In this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the buyer is instructed to return the slave girl along with a compensation for the 'fruition' (istimta') derived from copulation, reflecting the pre-modern juristic view that pregnancy serves as a primary indicator of virginity and fitness for sale. This highlights the concept of 'khiyarat' (options) in sales contracts, where a defect or change in status allows for restitution, ensuring the seller bears the risk of the slave's condition prior to the buyer's consummation.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, from someone else, from Aban, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>,

about the man who buys the slave girl, so he falls upon her, and he finds her as pregnant. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should return her, and return something along with her (for having copulated with her)’.
en.sarwar: 7. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Aban from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would not return a non-pregnant slave-girl after doing sexual intercourse but he (the Imam) would deduct from her price proportionate to the cost of the defect.’”
